title: commands/<worldId>.json
description: Give commands of one world for the Commands tab. Array order is display order. The custom name and the target selector are built by site/js/lib/commands.js and never stored here.

item.description: Minecraft item id without namespace, e.g. diamond_sword.

enchantments.description: SNBT map of the enchantments component, e.g. {unbreaking:3,mending:1}. Levels 1 to 255, unique ids and no custom_name are checked by cross validation (X25).

count.description: Item count written after the components. Omit it to end the command at ] (the game gives one item).
